# DIYAR Marketplace

> Arabic-first furniture and home-services marketplace for Saudi Arabia.

DIYAR (ديار) connects customers with furniture vendors and home service providers — catalog shopping, checkout, loyalty, B2B, and service bookings.

## Primary URLs

- [Home](/): storefront landing page
- [Catalog](/category/all): browse all product categories
- [Search](/search): product and service search
- [Services](/services): book home and design services
- [Blog](/blog): design inspiration and guides
- [B2B directory](/b2b): business partner listings
- [AI designer](/ai-designer): room visualization (early access)

## API

- [Public REST API](/api/v1/): JSON endpoints for catalog, cart, and checkout
- [Health check](/api/v1/health): service availability probe

## Languages

- Arabic (ar) — default, RTL
- English (en) — LTR

## Crawling

- [Robots policy](/robots.txt): allows public storefront pages
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): primary landing URLs

## Contact

Support email and phone are configured in platform settings and shown in the site footer.
